Using the shape table's normalized cooling profile together with the trend model for time-to-45°C, the temperature for batch 18 at 7.9 min is estimated as follows.

For batch 18, predicted time to reach 45 °C from the exponential model:  
\(t_{45} = 32.7764 + 10410.9\bigl(e^{8.17026\times10^{-6}\cdot 18} - 1\bigr) \approx 34.31\ \text{min}\).

From the reference curve, 45 °C occurs at \(x \approx 0.6125\) (interpolated between \(x=0.600,\ 45.45\ °\text{C}\) and \(x=0.625,\ 44.55\ °\text{C}\)).  
Total cooling span \(= 34.31 / 0.6125 \approx 56.0\ \text{min}\).  
At \(t = 7.9\ \text{min}\), normalized fraction \(x = 7.9 / 56.0 \approx 0.141\).

Interpolating the reference curve between \(x=0.125\ (72.998\ °\text{C})\) and \(x=0.150\ (70.883\ °\text{C})\) gives:  
\(T_c \approx 72.998 - 2.115 \times \frac{0.141-0.125}{0.025} \approx 71.6\ °\text{C}\).

FINAL ESTIMATE: 71.6 °C
